about.story: It is said: 'If you live your passion you never work a day in your life!' — that is how the dream of Little Caterpillars emerged and became the reality it is today! Little Caterpillars is a fun and professional child day care facility run by a dynamic team who are as passionate about giving your child(ren) the best early education possible as you, the parents, are. Our centre offers a safe and secure environment located in Midrand. Children from the age of 3 months to 6 years are welcome and together with her team of competent and qualified personnel, Natalie ensures that each child is properly supervised and cared for.
about.mission: The mission of Little Caterpillars is to provide a safe, stimulating and caring environment for children aged 3 months to 6 years. Our focus is to encourage an education experience promoting social, emotional, physical and cognitive development. Committed to the families we serve, we strive to give parents complete peace of mind, while being seen as a shining example of what a childcare centre should be.
about.vision: The ultimate vision we have for our facility is twofold, and rooted in both the present and the future. For the present, our goal is for parents to feel good about their childcare choice, and that the children are safe, engaged, educated and smiling. And for the future, we want these children to warmly look back at their experience with us, and see it as a cherished part of their childhood.
about.commitment: Our philosophy is simple. Little Caterpillars is here to offer your children the care and comfort, fun and safety they deserve. And for you, the peace of mind that comes from knowing your child is in the best of hands. Each day promises an exciting new adventure, and we make sure each child experiences the joys of a truly caring childcare facility.

classes.name: Butterfly Class
classes.subtitle: Baby Centre
facts: A maximum of 10 babies in the Baby Centre.
A qualified teacher and an assistant.
A daily communication book covering nappy changes, feeds and naps.
classes.body: Our Baby Centre takes babies from three months. The room is capped at ten babies and staffed by a qualified teacher with an assistant, so there is always a familiar pair of hands. Every baby goes home with a communication book recording nappy changes, feeds and naps — so you know how the day went before you have even put the bags down.

classes.name: Dragonfly Class
classes.body: The Dragonflies are on the move. This year is about gross motor development through play — the walking, running and stopping milestones that come thick and fast between one and two.

classes.name: Caterpillar Class
facts: Fine motor, gross motor and cognitive development.
Language, movement, hand and finger skills, emotional and social growth.
classes.body: The Caterpillars work to a weekly theme. Across the week the syllabus covers fine motor and gross motor work, cognitive development, language, movement, hand and finger skills, and the emotional and social side of being three.

classes.name: Busy Bees Class
classes.subtitle: Reception year
facts: Gross motor and kinaesthetics, music, art and science.
classes.body: The reception year, aimed squarely at Grade 1 readiness. Literacy, life skills and numeracy sit alongside gross motor and kinaesthetic work, music, art and science.

teachers.name: Jenice
teachers.bio: A qualified Foundation Phase teacher with five years' experience and a real passion for Grade 0.

teachers.name: Lina
teachers.bio: A qualified Foundation Phase teacher with twenty-five years behind her — and, in the school's own words, "a very soft hearted teacher".
